title: Daemon start must detach the child process from the operator shell on Windows
symptoms: daemon-start returns a new pid but the process exits when the launcher shell ends
state file shows cycle=0 or cycle=1 with no lasting heartbeat
root_cause: PowerShell Start-Process from the operator shell did not reliably detach the daemon from the parent job lifetime.
fix: Launch factory_daemon.py through a detached subprocess with DETACHED_PROCESS and CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP
Verify the returned pid against factory_daemon_state.json before reporting success
